bugs.title: Range lamp chatters at the 50 °C threshold (no hysteresis)
bugs.description: updateRangeLamp (lines 25-29) compares the reported temperature against HIGH_C with a hard `c <= HIGH_C` test and no hysteresis or debounce, so when the probe sits near 50 °C any ADC noise flips D7 every loop iteration. The measured evidence shows D7 in the wrong state for 3584 ms across 1365 intervals in the threshold-hover scenario, and 2660 ms across 1062 intervals at the 50 °C boundary, i.e. the lamp toggles instead of holding a level. D7 was in the wrong state for 3332 ms across 1403 interval(s), first at 502 ms: D7 was not LOW for 2 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

bugs.title: Range lamp chatters at the -10 °C threshold (no hysteresis)
bugs.description: The same hard comparison in updateRangeLamp (line 27) applies at the LOW_C edge, so a probe held at -10.0 °C with noise straddles the threshold and D7 flickers. Measured: D7 was in the wrong state for 3332 ms across 1403 intervals in the -10 °C boundary scenario, and 4739 ms across 15 intervals during a bouncy freeze press, because each bounce re-latches frozenC (lines 51-54) and the lamp is driven from that transient value (lines 56-57). D7 was in the wrong state for 2660 ms across 1062 interval(s), first at 500 ms: D7 was not LOW for 2 ms while required (grace 500 ms).
